conbody.p: This section describes the mobile devices and the OS versions compatible with the .

To commission a new , a mobile device is mandatory. You can use a smartphone or a tablet with either Android or iOS operating system. The mobile device must be able to connect to the plant’s Wi-Fi network.
conbody.note: You cannot use a Windows tablet.
